text: でも　ぜんぶ　ひろって　たら　じかん　なくなっちゃう！

structure.jp: ぜんぶ　ひろって　たら
structure.en: if you go picking up everything

structure.jp: じかん　なくなっちゃう！

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら means 'if'. Here it sits on the short form of ひろっている, so it is 'if you keep on picking up'. ひろって たら = 'if you're busy picking them up'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちゃう is the casual short form of てしまう, which says the thing happens completely, often to your regret. なくなっちゃう = 'it'll all be gone'.
